prelaunch_identity_freeze.record_location_policy: record_path is resolved relative to the exact A6 source release root and must be a regular external sibling outside that source tree so the record can bind a6_source_release_sha256 without self-reference
prelaunch_identity_freeze.protocol_manifest_digest_policy: SHA-256 of the exact protocol-manifest bytes is stored in the separate materialized record to avoid a self-referential digest
prelaunch_identity_freeze.materialized_launch_identity_policy: SHA-256 of the canonical required launch fields is stored separately from protocol_manifest_sha256
prelaunch_identity_freeze.source_release_identity_policy: a6_source_release_sha256 is the canonical tree digest recomputed from a deterministic sorted member manifest against the exact source release root; hashing an unverified self-described manifest alone is insufficient
source_release_rejections: unsafe, duplicate, unsorted, missing, undeclared, or symlinked members
secret, credential, cache, result, output, runtime, and generated evidence roots
prelaunch_identity_freeze.fail_closed_rule: no A6 seed, Evolver, candidate, or scored model call may start while the record or clean source-release manifest is absent, pending, malformed, digest-inconsistent, or different from the effective launch plan

discovery_design.evolver_instruction: Use the repeated train-only baseline outcomes and the fresh structured worker traces, finals, process summaries, and artifacts to discover and test one transferable harness mechanism. Verify the deterministic index against raw evidence. Do not specialize to task IDs. The coordinator prescribes no component, file, root cause, or implementation.

evidence_representation_increment.held_fixed: failure_type_v1 decision contract, constrained_evidence_profile_v1 probe policy, shared seed evidence, panel, model, provider, and runtime
evidence_representation_increment.changed: separately indexed exact public instructions and clauses

semantic_contract_package_increment.held_fixed: public_instruction_clause_index_v1 evidence, shared seed evidence, panel, model, provider, and runtime
semantic_contract_package_increment.changed: semantic_contract_v1 plus typed_contract_artifact_trace_v1 and required ACT semantic comparison

semantic_evidence_layout.source_role_manifest: the exact verified public role MANIFEST.json whose SHA-256 is already pinned by the ten-field prelaunch identity
semantic_evidence_layout.source_instruction_members_digest: canonical SHA-256 over each frozen task instruction source path and exact bytes; copied into the E/EC evidence contract and rederived from the live verified public role root before any model call

a6_ec_act_minimum_evidence: one cited exact public contract clause
one exact worker-observable artifact or trace fact
one typed semantic comparison linking the clause, artifact field, and trace phase
one executed answer-free probe that eliminates a competing hypothesis
bundle_matching: all three arms use the same 16-task fresh seed traces, finals, process summaries, and produced artifacts
A6-R and A6-E differ only by the added semantic evidence representation
A6-E and A6-EC receive byte-identical semantic evidence members; only the discovery-contract package differs
A6-E and A6-EC bind the same public role manifest SHA-256 and canonical source-instruction member digest; an internally self-consistent corpus from another checkout or role tree is rejected
arm-specific contract files are excluded when checking shared evidence-member equality
allowed_evidence: frozen evolution-train public inputs and public metadata
worker-observable traces, final answers, process summaries, and produced artifacts
deterministic answer-free indexes and arm-authorized probe outputs
forbidden_evidence: validation task identity, inputs, traces, scores, or outcomes
test task identity, inputs, traces, scores, or outcomes
diagnostic task identity, inputs, traces, scores, or outcomes
official tests, official solutions, expected or reference values, raw verifier verdicts, and credentials

feedback_exposure_plan.core_rule: A6-R, A6-E, and A6-EC receive the same L1 evaluator-outcome exposure; feedback exposure is not changed inside the three-arm discovery staircase

L0.label: trajectory_only
allowed: worker-produced artifacts and process or lifecycle status
L0.forbidden: all official reward, test-count, verifier-derived, expected-value, and reference-answer information

L1.label: aggregate_outcome_answer_free
allowed_increment_over_L0: aggregate passed and failed test counts when already authorized by the frozen train evidence contract
L1.forbidden: test names, assertion text, expected or actual values, stack or source lines, raw stdout, raw verdict objects, verifier code, official solutions, and references

L2.label: deterministic_public_clause_localization
L2.purpose: minimum proposed feedback increment for the optional A6-F arm
allowed_increment_over_L1: one categorical state from observed_missing, observed_inconsistent, or not_assessable
a public artifact path and field when that path and field are already named by the public contract
a coarse nonnumeric failure family from an allowlist frozen before evaluator execution
L2.forbidden: test names or counts by test, assertion or exception text, expected or actual values, raw stdout or CTRF, stack traces, source locations, verifier implementation details, private rubric concepts, and any generated natural-language hint

L3.label: masked_verifier_fragments
L3.examples: test names or verifier fragments with numeric values masked
L3.a6_policy: high leakage risk; excluded from A6

L4.label: raw_oracle_feedback
L4.examples: raw verifier output, verifier code, hidden tests, expected or actual values, official solutions, gold answers, and private rubric verdicts

optional_arm.label: semantic_contract_plus_minimal_sanitized_feedback
optional_arm.held_fixed: shared seed evidence, public clause representation, semantic_contract_v1, typed_contract_artifact_trace_v1, panel, model, provider, runtime, max_components, and admission rules
optional_arm.changed: add only the deterministic L2 public-clause-localized feedback channel
trigger: A6-EC validly ABSTAINs because grounded public clause-artifact-trace comparisons remain not_assessable or insufficiently contrastive
or A6-EC produces a false-ACT whose preregistered audit localizes the missing discriminator to feedback unavailable at L1 rather than to a malformed hypothesis or probe
skip_conditions: A6-EC already produces a supported ACT or calibrated ABSTAIN without an L1 feedback-sufficiency ceiling
the L2 sanitizer or its predeclared public-clause mapping fails any safety preflight
the trigger can be stated only after reading raw verifier material not covered by the trusted audit protocol
optional_arm.interpretation: exploratory single-variable feedback localization; one sequential sample cannot establish a feedback-effect claim

L2_safety_preflight: freeze a deterministic allowlisted mapping from public clause identifiers to coarse failure families before any run
run synthetic canary tests proving expected values, test names, assertion text, stack lines, and unrecognized fields become not_assessable rather than pass through
run protected-corpus exact, n-gram, and semantic leakage scans inside the trusted verifier boundary and export only pass, fail, or not_assessable status
taint-label every verifier-derived field and reject any output outside the L2 schema
mount no verifier filesystem, official solution, hidden test, credential, or raw verdict surface into the worker or Evolver sandbox
scan candidate diffs for protected substrings and suspicious constants before admission
use evolution-train lineage only; validation, test, and diagnostic material remain unavailable
freeze the sanitizer digest, public mapping digest, and evidence-bundle digest before A6-F

coverage_sentinels.selection_reason: only execution_microstructure train task with normal verifier exit and non-empty official test counts in all five baseline repetitions
only fully observable rates_fx_macro train task with repeated baseline successes; supplies a same-domain success-side contrast for the two rates targets

selection.policy: select all six clean 0/5 evolution-train failures, all eight 5/5 evolution-train successes as strict protections, and exactly two explicitly volatile sentinels needed for six-domain coverage and a rates success-side contrast
coverage_limitations: data_engineering has no successful task in the frozen evolution-train split
execution_microstructure has only one task with valid non-empty verifier evidence in all five repetitions
the two sentinels are baseline-variable and are not strict protections
all tasks are fixed train-panel members and are not independent draws from a task population

historical_panel_reference.interpretation: historical base-worker repetitions describe panel volatility only; they are not fresh A6 seed measurements and are not pooled with A6 outcomes

false_act.definition: an arm chooses ACT and its preregistered primary component-specific observable prediction is falsified by the candidate audit or evaluation
false_act.report: binary per arm plus count across arms; ABSTAIN is not coded as false-ACT

unsupported_semantic_leaps.definition: selected-mechanism claims that assert a public requirement, artifact fact, trace fact, or causal link without an exact authorized citation and resolvable relation
unsupported_semantic_leaps.report: count and audited-claim denominator per arm; structurally unavailable clause links in A6-R are marked unavailable rather than silently passed

grounded_clause_artifact_trace_compariso.definition: a resolvable comparison containing an exact clause identifier, artifact path and field, trace phase or slice, and an explicit supported, contradicted, or insufficient relation
grounded_clause_artifact_trace_compariso.report: valid count, attempted count, and coverage over selected hypotheses; A6-R is not expected to have the new clause representation

abstain_calibration.definition: ABSTAIN with writes locked, unresolved comparisons or insufficient contrast recorded, and no authorized evidence that satisfies that arm's ACT gate
abstain_calibration.report: procedural calibration audit, not proof that the surviving causal explanation is true

matched_discovery_contrasts.A6-E_vs_A6-R: evidence-representation increment under the same failure_type_v1 contract
matched_discovery_contrasts.A6-EC_vs_A6-E: semantic-contract and typed-probe package increment under byte-identical semantic evidence
matched_discovery_contrasts.first_round_interpretation: one stochastic Evolver sample per arm is a localization canary and cannot support a causal arm-effect or significance claim

secondary_reward_estimand.name: paired_six_domain_macro_delta
secondary_reward_estimand.unit: fixed task, aggregated within domain and then across domains
secondary_reward_estimand.scope: computed separately over all 16 tasks for every ACT arm; includes volatile sentinels and is descriptive only; never select or pool the best arm
secondary_reward_estimand.single_canary_interpretation: secondary descriptive in-panel adaptation effect; not a stochastic-repetition estimate

stable_advancement_reward_estimand.name: paired_stable_five_domain_macro_delta
stable_advancement_reward_estimand.formula: mean_domain(mean_task(reward_candidate - reward_shared_fresh_seed)) over the six targets and eight strict protections only
stable_advancement_reward_estimand.scope: advancement gate only; sentinels remain a separate blast-radius report
stable_advancement_reward_estimand.interpretation: engineering threshold for considering independent repetitions, not a significance claim

required_reports: all four primary discovery audits for every arm, including explicit not-applicable and missing states
the A6-E versus A6-R and A6-EC versus A6-E matched contrasts without pooling arms
all 16 paired task-level official reward deltas
six paired all-panel domain means and the descriptive six-domain macro delta
five paired stable-panel domain means and the 14-task advancement macro delta
target, strict-protection, and volatile-sentinel results separately
official reward separately from test-pass fraction, completion status, process metrics, latency, tool errors, tokens, and cost

candidate_advancement_thresholds.interpretation: a threshold pass authorizes consideration of a frozen independent-repetition stage; reward alone cannot rescue an unsupported ACT and is not a significance claim

matched_contrast_replication_trigger.rule: repeat a complete matched arm pair only when the first round discriminates on a primary discovery endpoint in the predicted direction
eligible_signals: one arm produces false-ACT and its matched arm avoids it through a protocol-calibrated ABSTAIN or a supported ACT
the increment removes at least one unsupported selected-mechanism semantic leap while preserving resolvable evidence
the increment produces at least one additional valid grounded clause-artifact-trace comparison used in the terminal decision

single_canary_uncertainty.exact_task_label_or_sign_randomization: descriptive sensitivity only; task exchangeability and non-adaptive assignment do not hold strongly enough for a causal p-value
single_canary_uncertainty.domain_cluster_bootstrap: report only as unstable sensitivity because there are six fixed domains and execution_microstructure is a singleton

multiple_testing.first_round_discovery_endpoints: audited mechanistic outcomes with no p-values because n=1 Evolver sample per arm
multiple_testing.secondary_reward_primary_family: one descriptive all-16 six-domain macro and one stable-14 five-domain advancement macro per ACT arm; report arms separately and do not choose the smallest p-value or largest gain
multiple_testing.strict_protections: familywise fail-closed safety gate; any official reward regression fails advancement
multiple_testing.per_task_and_process_metrics: descriptive in the canary; if tested in a later confirmatory run, apply Holm correction within each declared family
multiple_testing.no_optional_stopping: do not add tasks, repetitions, hypotheses, or outcomes after inspecting A6 results

follow_up_evolver_repetitions.interpretation: sample size is an engineering lower bound; a formal false-ACT-rate design requires a separate power calculation

follow_up_worker_repetitions.candidate_state: freeze candidate digest before any confirmatory repetition
follow_up_worker_repetitions.unit_for_primary_inference: paired repetition-block stable 14-task five-domain macro delta; the all-16 six-domain macro remains descriptive because its sixth domain is a volatile singleton sentinel
follow_up_worker_repetitions.execution: fresh seed and frozen-candidate draws for every task in every block, with preregistered counterbalanced order and unchanged route/runtime
follow_up_worker_repetitions.exact_sign_flip_resolution_at_six_blocks: 2^6 assignments; minimum attainable two-sided p-value is 0.03125 only under the exchangeable-label sharp null
follow_up_worker_repetitions.extension_rule: six inconclusive blocks remain inconclusive; an unplanned extension to ten cannot be used as the same confirmatory test

mutation_ablation_plan.separation_rule: do not vary mutation amplitude, proposal throughput, evidence representation, semantic contract, or evaluator feedback in the same first-round contrast
mutation_ablation_plan.prerequisite: freeze one discovery evidence, contract, and feedback regime after the core R/E/EC localization and any separately triggered A6-F run

current_core_envelope.instruction: make the narrowest coherent improvement supported by evidence

measured_local_context.old_10iter_run: only four proposal iterations completed: three systemprompt-only non-empty diffs with 32, 40, and 12 inserted lines, followed by one empty diff; no candidate was kept
measured_local_context.A1: manual canary, two changed paths, 35 insertions and 3 deletions, one Markdown skill plus agent.yaml registration, no executable Python or new AST symbols
measured_local_context.A2: one Evolver proposal, three changed paths, 90 insertions, one Markdown skill plus agent.yaml registration and prompt pointer, no executable Python or new AST symbols
measured_local_context.A3: one Evolver proposal, three changed paths, 71 insertions, one Markdown skill plus agent.yaml registration and prompt pointer, no executable Python or new AST symbols
measured_local_context.A4: one Evolver proposal, systemprompt only, 68 insertions and 1 deletion, no executable Python or binding change
measured_local_context.A5: failure-only ACT changed systemprompt and one tool description with 24 insertions and 2 deletions; contrastive arm ABSTAINed with no diff; neither arm added executable Python or bindings
measured_local_context.interpretation: this is measured evidence that the prior search was narrow and low-throughput for general full-harness discovery, while A1-A5 remain valid mechanism-localization canaries

M0.policy: current A6 envelope and narrowest coherent change

M1.policy: replace narrowest coherent change with smallest causally complete change; dependency and binding closure count as part of coherence

M2.policy: permit a coupled executable bundle such as tool implementation, tool description, agent binding, middleware, and prompt or skill routing; do not require code when the causal hypothesis is genuinely text-only
M2.line_cap: no arbitrary LOC target; record observed files, LOC, AST symbols, component roles, dependencies, and bindings

M3.policy: full admissible mutation surface with the same firewall and admission gates
M3.availability: only after a preregistered M2 truncation signal and a new cost authorization

replace_narrowest_with_causally_complete: the selected mechanism's static dependency graph requires a binding or implementation omitted by a text-only change
a preflight manipulation check shows that the proposal is prompt-only or empty despite a preregistered executable or routing prediction
relax_max_components_from_3_to_5: admission records component_closure_truncated=true for a selected mechanism with more than three necessary dependency or binding roles
at least two independent Evolver samples select the same greater-than-three-role causal closure
a repeated false-ACT audit localizes failure to an omitted binding or dependency rather than to an incorrect hypothesis
do_not_relax_for: a desire to imitate a larger external diff without a matching causal object
mutation breadth without an activation or component-specific prediction

T3.generation: freeze all three independent proposals before any candidate score is observed; proposals share evidence but cannot inspect one another
operator_roles: coupled structural or executable change with explicit dependency and binding closure
recombination or translocation from the frozen train-lineage archive

T6.availability: only after T3 demonstrates non-duplicate proposal diversity and a nonzero preflight or sentinel admission yield, with a new cost authorization

operator_policy.translocation: allowed from frozen evolution-train candidate ancestry with source and backbone digests recorded
operator_policy.crossover: allowed only when two frozen parents have non-overlapping positive target signatures and compatible strict-protection signatures
operator_policy.parallel_generation: allowed, but every accepted provider request, candidate digest, and generation role counts toward the same budget
operator_policy.selection: never score only the candidate that sounds most promising; report the entire frozen portfolio

checks: unique non-empty diff digest and duplicate-candidate detection
changed-file, insertion, deletion, executable-versus-text, component-role, dependency, binding, and AST-symbol inventory
JSON and YAML schema validation, Python parse and compile, import and NexAU binding resolution
candidate runtime smoke for every changed executable or binding
forbidden-path, credential, protected-substring, suspicious-constant, and evaluator-leak scans
declared mechanism, changed-role, actual-diff, activation-route, target prediction, and protection prediction alignment

sentinel_stage.purpose: fixed triage over all six repeat-failure targets plus two strict protections; never a headline score or a substitute for the full panel
pass_gate: no official reward regression on either strict protection
the preregistered component-specific observable process or activation prediction appears on at least one predicted target

full_panel_stage.policy: evaluate every preflight- and sentinel-passing candidate, up to the frozen portfolio cap; do not evaluate only the best sentinel candidate
full_panel_stage.analysis: report every candidate separately plus portfolio proposal diversity, preflight yield, sentinel yield, full-panel advancement yield, and cost per admitted candidate

staged_sequence: first hold throughput at T1 and compare whether M0 versus M2 creates a real amplitude manipulation; one sample is localization only
then freeze the causally complete amplitude envelope and compare T1 versus T3 as a separate search-yield experiment
consider crossover, M3, or T6 only after the corresponding predeclared trigger
repeat complete portfolios, not selected winners, before any search-yield inference

planning_attempt_counts.M0_vs_M2_if_both_candidates_reach_full_p: 16 shared seed plus 16 sentinel plus 32 full-panel candidate scores equals 64 official scoring attempts
planning_attempt_counts.one_T3_portfolio_if_all_candidates_reach: 16 shared seed plus 24 sentinel plus 48 full-panel candidate scores equals 88 official scoring attempts
planning_attempt_counts.interpretation: sentinel scores are triage-only and are not pooled into the fresh full-panel estimate

stop_rules: stop before evidence construction on any split, task, benchmark, image, worker, model, provider, fallback, route, or runtime digest drift
stop and quarantine on evaluator-firewall leakage, duplicate accepted model requests, missing cost or token records, invalid verifier execution, or unresolved lifecycle residue
skip A6-F unless its predeclared feedback-sufficiency trigger and every L2 safety preflight hold; never fall through to L3 or L4 feedback
ABSTAIN is terminal within its arm and keeps that arm's candidate writes locked
evaluate every admitted ACT candidate once on the frozen 16-task panel, up to three candidate evaluations; never choose only the most promising ACT
a false-ACT or unsupported selected-mechanism semantic leap stops that candidate lineage regardless of reward
stop without multi-round evolution if the arm-specific ACT gate, component-specific prediction, practical-effect threshold, or strict-protection gate fails
do not name a winning arm or make a representation or contract-effect claim from one Evolver sample per arm
do not mix the feedback or mutation ablations into the R/E/EC core and do not select only the best-looking portfolio candidate
freeze an advancing candidate before independent repetitions; do not tune it on repetition outcomes

cost_plan.basis: linear extrapolation from measured A5 worker and Evolver runs for one shared 16-task seed, three Evolver arms, and the worst case in which all three arms ACT and each candidate is evaluated on 16 tasks

optional_A6_F_increment_if_triggered.basis: one additional approximately USD 0.06 Evolver sample plus one 16-task candidate evaluation at the A5-derived linear rate; skip or ABSTAIN reduces the realized total

cost_plan.mutation_ablation_costs: not included in the A6 core or optional A6-F cap and require a separately frozen plan and authorization
